findings.title: ':latest' tag used
findings.message:
Artifact: Dockerfile
Type: dockerfile
Vulnerability DS-0001
Severity: MEDIUM
Message: Specify a tag in the 'FROM' statement for image 'alpine'
Link: [DS-0001](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ds-0001)

findings.title: Image user should not be 'root'
findings.message:
Artifact: Dockerfile
Type: dockerfile
Vulnerability DS-0002
Severity: HIGH
Message: Specify at least 1 USER command in Dockerfile with non-root user as argument
Link: [DS-0002](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ds-0002)

findings.title: 'apk add' is missing '--no-cache'
findings.message:
Artifact: Dockerfile
Type: dockerfile
Vulnerability DS-0025
Severity: HIGH
Message: '--no-cache' is missed: apk add curl
Link: [DS-0025](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ds-0025)

findings.title: No HEALTHCHECK defined
findings.message:
Artifact: Dockerfile
Type: dockerfile
Vulnerability DS-0026
